_comment: PRD section 12 puts the production website on the owner's own hosting. The 'hosting' block below is a preview deployment only — a public URL for checking the app on a phone or another computer before the real domain is set up. Deploy it with: flutter build web --release && firebase deploy --only hosting

rewrites._comment: PRD section 3 uses path URLs with no '#', so every unknown path has to fall back to index.html or a refresh on /plans would 404. This is the Firebase equivalent of web/.htaccess (PRD section 12 step 2), which only applies to Apache hosting.

headers._comment: The Flutter build is content-hashed, so its assets can be cached hard. index.html must not be, or a deploy would not reach anyone until their cache expired.
